list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM analytics_events ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Conversion funnel (identity resolved at query time)
panels.description: Persons reaching each ordered step. Anonymous ids are collapsed to their identified person via analytics_person_aliases before counting.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT coalesce(a.distinct_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.event AS event, e.timestamp AS ts
  FROM analytics_events e
  LEFT JOIN analytics_person_aliases a ON a.previous_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(e.timestamp)
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT person,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_uploaded')  AS s0,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_processed') AS s1,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='search_performed')   AS s2,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='chat_started')        AS s3
  FROM resolved GROUP BY person
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL) AS c0,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL AND s1 IS NOT NULL AND s1>=s0) AS c1,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL AND s1 IS NOT NULL AND s1>=s0 AND s2 IS NOT NULL AND s2>=s1) AS c2,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL AND s1 IS NOT NULL AND s1>=s0 AND s2 IS NOT NULL AND s2>=s1 AND s3 IS NOT NULL AND s3>=s2) AS c3
  FROM firsts
)
SELECT step, reached FROM (VALUES
  (1,'1 · uploaded',  (SELECT c0 FROM counts)),
  (2,'2 · processed', (SELECT c1 FROM counts)),
  (3,'3 · searched',  (SELECT c2 FROM counts)),
  (4,'4 · chatted',   (SELECT c3 FROM counts))
) AS t(ord, step, reached) ORDER BY ord

panels.title: End-to-end conversion
panels.description: Persons who completed all four steps in order, as a share of those who entered.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT coalesce(a.distinct_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.event AS event, e.timestamp AS ts
  FROM analytics_events e
  LEFT JOIN analytics_person_aliases a ON a.previous_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(e.timestamp)
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT person,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_uploaded') AS s0,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='chat_started')       AS s3,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_processed') AS s1,
    min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='search_performed')   AS s2
  FROM resolved GROUP BY person
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL) AS c0,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE s0 IS NOT NULL AND s1 IS NOT NULL AND s1>=s0 AND s2 IS NOT NULL AND s2>=s1 AND s3 IS NOT NULL AND s3>=s2) AS c3
  FROM firsts
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c0>0 THEN round(100.0*c3/c0, 1) ELSE 0 END AS conversion_pct FROM counts

SELECT date_trunc('day', timestamp) AS time, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS dau
FROM analytics_events
WHERE project = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT event, count(*) AS events
FROM analytics_events
WHERE project = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Weekly retention cohorts
panels.description: For each weekly cohort (anchored on first document_uploaded), distinct people active N weeks later. Identity resolved through aliases.

targets.rawSql:
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT coalesce(a.distinct_id, e.distinct_id) AS person, e.event AS event, e.timestamp AS ts
  FROM analytics_events e
  LEFT JOIN analytics_person_aliases a ON a.previous_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = '$project'
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT person, date_trunc('week', min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_uploaded')) AS cohort_week
  FROM resolved GROUP BY person
  HAVING min(ts) FILTER (WHERE event='document_uploaded') IS NOT NULL
),
activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.person, c.cohort_week,
    (extract(epoch FROM (date_trunc('week', r.ts) - c.cohort_week)) / 604800)::int AS period
  FROM cohorts c JOIN resolved r ON r.person = c.person WHERE r.ts >= c.cohort_week
)
SELECT to_char(cohort_week,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS cohort, period, count(DISTINCT person) AS active
FROM activity WHERE period BETWEEN 0 AND 6
GROUP BY cohort_week, period ORDER BY cohort_week, period

SELECT timestamp, event, distinct_id, session_id, correlation_id
FROM analytics_events
WHERE project = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
